the MAIAC aeros- ol retrievals are the most reliable at high spatial resolutions in the absence of unresolved cloud and snow contamination, and that the new cloud/snow screening method described in this paper significantly improves the reliability of the retrievals in the presence of unresolved cloud and/or snow.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the developed technique is an efficient and reliable method for the cloud/snow screening in the MAIAC aeroso- l retrieval algorithm.

we have developed and validated an improved cloud/snow filter for the MAIAC algorithm, which is implemented in the MAIAC aerosols retrieval and has shown to significantly suppress the optical thickness outliers due to unresolved clouds.
we have shown the importance of the cloud and snow screening for high resolution data, and have developed an improved technique for the cloud and snow filtering in high resolution data.

the cloud/snow screening based on spectral and spatial analysis can be successfully used in high spatial resolution retrievals of aerosol properties.
